mime/word#

RFC 2047 encoded words, for non-ASCII text in mail header fields.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

EncodedWord("Grüße").string();                    // "=?UTF-8?B?R3LDvMOfZQ==?="
DecodedWords("=?utf-8?b?R3LDvMOfZQ==?=").string(); // "Grüße"

Description#

RFC 2047 encoded words, for non-ASCII text in mail header fields.
